name: Sarkhan, Soul Aflame
oracle_text:
Dragon spells you cast cost {1} less to cast.
Whenever a Dragon you control enters, you may have Sarkhan become a copy of it until end of turn, except its name is Sarkhan, Soul Aflame and it's legendary in addition to its other types.
blocked_sentences: Whenever a Dragon you control enters, you may have Sarkhan become a copy of it until end of turn, except its name is Sarkhan, Soul Aflame and it's legendary in addition to its other types.

needs.what: an `add_supertypes` key in `become_copy`'s `except_` (707.9b), written into the copy's copiable values the way `copy_permanent`'s except_ already honours add_supertypes, so "becomes a copy of it until end of turn, except its name is Sarkhan, Soul Aflame and it's legendary in addition to its other types" is become_copy with copying {binding: subject}, duration end_of_turn, except_name "Sarkhan, Soul Aflame" and except_ {"add_supertypes": ["Legendary"]}
needs.why_existing_wont_do: become_copy's except_ is checked against loader.effects.BECOME_COPY_EXCEPT_KEYS, which is only add_keywords and keep_abilities; add_supertypes exists only on copy_permanent's COPY_EXCEPT_KEYS (a token copy, not an in-place copy). Dropping the clause would make Sarkhan a non-legendary copy, so the legend rule and anything counting legends would see a different card. No op (add_subtype, animate) adds a supertype as a later effect either, and that would not be a copiable value anyway. The rest is expressible: spell_cost_reduction with affects_spells subtypes Dragon, and a permanent_enters trigger filtered to Dragons you control wrapping become_copy in a may.
